name: Toronto Metropolitan University
summary: Downtown Toronto university with 60+ undergraduate programs, 4,450+ international students and co-op or internships in many degrees.

ib.text: IB Diploma with 4 or higher in 3 HL and 3 SL subjects, prerequisites included, and a total of 28 or more; bonus points count only on final results, not predicted ones. Competitive programs may ask for more.

dates.label: Guaranteed consideration date: fall 2027 applications and amendments

programmes.name: Mechatronics Engineering
programmes.about: Combine mechanical, electronic and computer engineering to design intelligent, automated systems: robotics, programming, circuits and microcontrollers, finishing with a team capstone project presented to industry experts.
programmes.ib: English, Maths with calculus, Physics and Chemistry at the Ontario Grade 12 level; TMU decides the IB equivalents. Co-op is available, as a 5-year route.

needs.note: Ontario Advanced Functions and Calculus; TMU sets the IB equivalents

programmes.selectionNote: Grades-only: previous years' Ontario range was 85-90%, with no IB conversion published, so ask TMU what total it expects. 28 is the Diploma minimum.

flagshipSource.title: Mechatronics Engineering: robotics, programming and an industry-facing capstone project

programmes.name: Journalism
programmes.about: Build journalistic techniques from the first day in industry-grade newsrooms, with multimedia reporting, tools for spotting misinformation and an internship available, in one of North America's large media hubs.
programmes.ib: English is a prerequisite and TMU decides the IB equivalent; Grades-Only admission, previous years' Ontario range 70-75%.
programmes.selectionNote: Grades-only: previous years' Ontario range was 70-75%, with no IB conversion published, so ask TMU what total it expects. 28 is the Diploma minimum.

flagshipSource.title: Journalism at The Creative School: industry-grade newsrooms, internships and a Toronto media-hub setting

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering and Architectural Science
faculties.line: Calculus is required for all engineering programs; English, Maths, Physics and Chemistry at Grade 12 level.

faculties.name: Ted Rogers School of Management
faculties.line: Calculus is required for Accounting & Finance; every program has required subjects and grades, set by TMU.

faculties.name: The Creative School
faculties.line: Journalism is grades-only; some Creative School programs add a portfolio, interview or audition by program.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Calculus is required for selected science programs; every program has required subjects and grades.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: English is required for every program; admission is on competitive overall averages and subject grades.

faculties.name: Faculty of Community Services
faculties.line: Prerequisite subjects and grades vary by program; some add non-academic requirements such as an interview.

notes: TMU offers two ways in: its own International Application (CAD 150) or the OUAC; students at Ontario secondary schools must use the OUAC for September entry.
International fees for 2026-27 range from CAD 38,693 to 44,675 depending on faculty, including ancillary fees.
IB Higher Level courses graded 5 or higher may earn transfer credit, except for core engineering courses.
